propositions: Mirror Guard workflow fails on single instantaneous sample of expected transient replication lag (~15s post-submit), incorrectly alerting on self-healing divergence.
The module's design docstring and sibling CloudWatch alarm both implement sustained-divergence windows for lag tolerance, but the primary workflow watcher has no evaluation window.
An in-process, scheduler-agnostic persistence wrapper is needed in the CLI path to re-sample across a configurable window and fail only when divergence persists.
The fix must preserve today's failure set for true outages (GitHub-ahead, stalled mirrors) while suppressing transient lag that converges within the window.
Integration requires no workflow functional changes, only a header comment update describing the new lag-tolerance semantics.
